title: Badass, an Origins Addon
description: Do you have what it takes?
body:
heavily inspired/based on soul knight

many textures/sound effects from soul knight

play the game, it is alot of fun...

![Soul Knight Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e878bac332f8e0053ee4088e08799470fb6782e_0.webp)

# about the pack
, choose between two difficulties, **Normal** or **Badass** mode

, if a player chooses **Badass** mode, the world difficulty is set to **Hard**

![Badass Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8230f34287fe4e9067b814c05520aec3e392f5d_0.webp)

![Origin GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d9b645cb01f90052efa07d2a0160137f0d6c30a.png)

, remain in normal mode for a standard minecraft experience, but lock out new exclusive advancements

, advancements are difficult, but have incentive for completing

![Advancements GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56968cec1a6de2e3a929555c076dd3a22d2ce528.png)

, newly added recipes can be viewed by searching for stone button : )

, the rest of the game will be slightly more difficult, especially when trying to obtain the new advancements... have fun !

_, dont forget to download the resourcepack and pehkui as a required mod_



 


 
![spooiilers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b217ee510e603e773c4779707894636d86bde98.png)



# spoiler content


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

, besides the debuffs you get from choosing Badass Mode, some special mobs may also spawn...

, vampires are faster zombies, healing overtime and on hits, while also inflicting weakness

, elites are bigger versions of hostile mobs, having more health and immune to most debuffs

![Special Mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fafe64cbb92789892dbafd7c49a6fefec5230a5.png)

</details>



<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

, the new advancements are difficult, but completing them each grant medals

, these can be traded for exclusives with certain villager professions

![Badass Medals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87719dce301d5f94a5f5b2b342574a1e60e12845.png)

, upon game completion, you are awarded with Sir Violet's Chalice, which allows you to remove debuffs obtained from Badass Mode

![Sir Violet's Chalice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8aa4e9cf77d4952ee03a7e5e6e650cae0cf9a07c.png)

</details>



<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

, 3 of the 6 advancements are extremely difficult, restricting you from attacking non-bare-handed. doing so prevents obtaining all 3 permanently

, to prevent accidental attacks and to help with the challenge, the player receives a Weapon Lock upon spawning, toggling damage and attack range to 0

![Barehanded](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c074ec60f07b29c94b3e3cc39036a62261afd318.png)

, each bare-handed advancement grants a Colored Voucher, applying a swing effect to bare-handed attacks

, you can only use these if you have the advancement : )

![Vouchers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8ef7d750a0d9a531c4ba41c9955bf27b54a9c7d.png)

![Barehanded Attack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfefb4d4a77c87ec6625761697456d8d5a3408d2.gif)


</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

, 5 new recipes are also available, which are the Knuckle variants

, each are unbreakable, are checked as bare-handed, and increase bare-handed damage by 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, and 2.5 respectively

![Knuckles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/360ad13fa688a4d34d777d3efbb744e4936a793b.png)

, 1 last recipe can be made, which is the Target Dummy

, cannot be moved/killed

, heals to full after 5 seconds of not taking damage

![Target Dummy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8fe8c23e4df4790494acd0ec7c3ba9f00a48523.png)

</details>





<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

, below are the exclusive villager trades unlocked by having atleast 1 Badass Medal

### Oathbreaker, Oathkeeper, and Warhammer of Sealed Souls
, Reskinned Netherite Swords

, Unbreakable

, Traded from Weaponsmith Villager for 1 Medal each

![Badass Mode Exclusive Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f30115340593b7a0eee9729fad64d7f2b9dc6c3f.gif)

### Sir Violet's and Sir Sangria's Helmets
, Reskinned Netherite Chestplates due to limitations... still worn on head

, Unbreakable

, Traded from Armorer Villager for 1 Medal each

![Helmets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/686eb010a0c5218cbb86685bcfd8b53ab31aecf3.png)

### Captain's Medal
, When it's wielder is struck, hails explosive cannon shells around that burn targets

, Unbreakable

, Traded from Toolsmith Villager for 1 Medal

![Captain's Medal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/116a0162a7984bc808a416d3a4c78080fd084c50.png)

### Complete Sets for Sir Violet and Sir Sangria
![Sir Violet Set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8633e098f942163cd57a4c82466ebdd80726a53.gif) ![Sir Sangria Set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/602d0a3eeba17a0e5661788e85d3ec667498842f.gif)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

below are some functions for world operators

### function misch:generic/grant_approval
, grants all advancements and awards Sir Violet's Approval

### function misch:generic/reset_advancements
, resets all advancements

### function misch:generic/reset_badass
, resets all advancements and badass mode advancements progress

### execute as [selector] run function misch:generic/make_elite
, turns selector into elite mob

### execute as [zombie] run function misch:generic/make_vampire
, turns selected zombie into vampire

### function misch:generic/give/secret_vouchers
, grants player all unob vouchers

### function misch:generic/give/[advancement/item name]
, grants player item related to function name

, ex : function misch:generic/give/paramount grants player 1 Badass Medal and Red Voucher

</details>
